text:
Aisha Patel: Quick weekly pulse — attaching the p95/p99 split by route and model for Emberly onboarding. Notably some tail in streaming for /chat and /summarize.
Marco Nguyen: saw that, looks like /chat -> gpt-3.5-likely is the biggest offender (p99 ~1.2s). p95s mostly fine.
Jess Carter: can you paste the numbers quickly?
Aisha Patel: sure — short summary: 
- /chat (streaming) model=redwood-chat-medium p95=320ms p99=1200ms
- /chat (non-stream) model=redwood-chat-medium p95=290ms p99=600ms
- /summarize (streaming) model=long-summarizer p95=410ms p99=1500ms
- /embed model=embed-base p95=80ms p99=140ms
(3d rolling windows, client side retries filtered)
Riley (metrics-bot): link to dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/ops/emberly-tail?org=emberly
Devon Li: Emberly just hit their first paid month — we should flag renewal risk if latency persists. They ran a big streaming batch this week for transcript ingestion.
Marco Nguyen: likely combo of sequence length + no KV cache hits. I see many cold starts on worker pool for streaming shards.
Jess Carter: do we have an immediate mitigation? Could we route heavy streaming to dedicated nodes or fall back to non-streaming?
Aisha Patel: options: 1) suggest client enable prefix caching (KV) — biggest win for repeated prompts; 2) temporary route policy: non-streaming on longer inputs for Emberly (reduce p99); 3) spin up dedicated burst pool for streaming for their tenant.
Marco Nguyen: I can try an internal experiment — enable KV caching for a subset and run A/B for 24h. If p99 drops by >30% we push recommendation.
Devon Li: ops to coordinate with Emberly PS next Tues. I'll schedule an enablement session covering prefix caching + best-practice prompt shapes.
Jess Carter: also ask them to try `stream=false` on long transcripts — often reduces tail because no incremental flush.
Aisha Patel: noted. Action items: 
- Marco: run KV A/B test (24h) — due EOD tomorrow.
- Devon: schedule enablement + capture acceptance criteria for renewal team.
- Jess: draft fallback route policy snippet for us to propose (can include code example).
Marco Nguyen: starting now. I'll post results as a follow-up thread.
Riley (metrics-bot): alert created: EMBERLY-STREAM-TAIL at 1719039000 (p99 > 1s on /summarize streaming).
Aisha Patel: tagging @Jess for renewal risk note — if A/B fails, we mark as medium risk and loop in CSM.
Jess Carter: got it. I'll update the renewal tracker and add the latency notes + proposed mitigations.
Devon Li: any immediate customer-facing comms? Short note: "We're investigating streaming tail and have options to reduce latency; will follow up after tests."
Aisha Patel: agree. I'll send that after Marco posts A/B quick results.
Marco Nguyen: A/B started — baseline p99 1.45s, initial KV-enabled run p99 820ms (first 6h). Promising.
Jess Carter: great. :thumbsup:
Aisha Patel: solid. I'll keep this thread as the record of decisions and paste final numbers once Marco completes 24h.
Devon Li: thanks all — I'll prep the enablement deck template and share before the PS call.
